name: OneWay
definition: OneWay is BlackRoad's controlled data-flow and sovereignty pipeline. OneWay means data goes one way into BlackRoad, gets mapped to BlackRoad identity/state/memory, then returns outward in the format the outside provider or client needs. The point is not 'export' in a boring sense. The point is to prevent external providers from becoming the durable owner of the user's data. If a ChatGPT API call or external provider request hits BlackRoad, OneWay can receive the request, rotate/map the identity, store the durable relationship inside BlackRoad, transform/encode the response path, and send back only what the external system needs.
core_promise: Your data can move through providers without becoming theirs.
